tagline: 奥林巴斯数码相机，2012 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2012年推出的数码相机。

specs.英文简介: The Olympus PEN mini E-PM2 is a very compact digital system camera for the Micro Four Thirds system, with the same small dimensions as its predecessor Olympus PEN mini E-PM1, but with grip element on the front side to give it ergonomy.
